free_tier.stated: Five routes (/api/groq, /api/ollama, /api/pollinations, /api/nvidia, /api/gemini) are listed as none required for an API key, but a chat call answered 402 insufficient_credits asking for proof-of-work credits to earn anonymous usage
free_tier.notes: the credit amount per call is not published; /v1 on the same host is listed as requiring a key from g4f.dev/api_key.html, though GET /v1/models answers 200 with no key

tooling: any OpenAI-compatible client with base URL https://g4f.space/api/<provider>; the doc says to pass a placeholder key for SDKs that require one
chaining: pairs with nothing until the credit scheme is understood: an anonymous call with no credit is refused

limits.value: a credit balance earned by proof-of-work: an anonymous chat call with none answers 402 insufficient_credits; the credits per call are unpublished

binding_note: the proof-of-work credit balance gates every anonymous completion

identity_cost.detail: no key for the /api/<provider> routes per the g4f.dev table (none required); the price is proof-of-work credits rather than an identity

reliability_note: GET /api/pollinations/models returns entries whose message is Error 404 DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND on Vercel, and /api/auto/models returns 404; the groq, ollama, nvidia and gemini listings answer 200
confidence_note: the listings were read by GET; the 402 on a chat call comes from a third-party hourly prober that sends chat calls with no Authorization header. No completion was sent, because probe issues GET and HEAD only

evidence.proved: the g4f.dev table lists the groq route as needing no API key

evidence.quote: 402 insufficient_credits: "No cake credits. Bake proof-of-work cakes ... to earn anonymous usage." Anonymous, but not free of charge -- the price is compute rather than a key.
evidence.proved: a third-party prober got 402 insufficient_credits on a keyless chat call to the g4f.space routes
the keyless GET /api/groq/models answered 200 and proxied the groq.com listing

notes: the five routes front other providers (groq.com, ollama.com, pollinations.ai, nvidia.com, a hosted Gemini provider) and the listings carry per-model request counters; the routes differ in availability
